notes: Battles now read as turns: a 'Your move' banner each turn, the action bar slides away while moves play out, and the acting side lights up
Before you choose, the game shows the type matchup, who moves first and when the foe has its Ultimate charged — so Guard and switching are real decisions
Every hit has a wind-up, a freeze-frame impact with a flash of type-coloured light, knockback and a recovery; signature moves and Ultimates get a name cut-in
New duel camera: over your creature's shoulder, close-ups on the attacker and the target, and it no longer hides behind trees or houses (they step aside for the fight)
Guard bubble, burning embers and paralysis sparks on the creatures, buff/debuff tags and status turns on the name plates
The world HUD hides during battles, grass is trampled flat in the arena, other wild Echoes keep out of the shot
PC: press 1-9 to pick an action
